general_information.Description: -Objective: To provide an overall and in-depth competence of wedding planning and management -Description: It gives a comprehensive and in-depth knowlodege of different aspects of wedding planning and management, starting from supplying a strong foundation knowledge in the cultural, historical, social, and political influences on weddings and marriage; to accommodating with all of the elements essential to the practice of planning weddings; as well as a clear overview of what it takes to start a wedding consulting business. -Teaching method: lecturing in combination with tutorial classes, case study analysis, real event planning practice
general_information.StudentTasks: - Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

description: -Objective: To provide an overall and in-depth competence of wedding planning and management -Description: It gives a comprehensive and in-depth knowlodege of different aspects of wedding planning and management, starting from supplying a strong foundation knowledge in the cultural, historical, social, and political influences on weddings and marriage; to accommodating with all of the elements essential to the practice of planning weddings; as well as a clear overview of what it takes to start a wedding consulting business. -Teaching method: lecturing in combination with tutorial classes, case study analysis, real event planning practice

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: To get an insight into the role of the wedding consultants and their appreciation of and sensitivity to the diverse needs of the clients
To establish the cultural, religious, historical, political and social context of the weddings
To examine the individual fundamental elements that together lead to the design and implementation of weddings
To develop procedures for the weddings and manage resources and logistics to ensure weddings are delivered in line with event plans
To monitor and evaluate events to ensure customer and business requirements are met
To achieve and practice a professional manner of an event planner with high sense of responsibility, detail orientedness, servicemind and teamwork spirit

assessments.Grading Guide: Option 1: -Students working in a team to make wedding plan for a real or potential couple (friends, relatives, celebrities...) - Each team will do the research about the couple, their style, situation to develop a master plan, operational plans, procedure and design for their wedding - The team has to develop different checklists and tools to control and evaluate the wedding and continously update with and get the feedback from the clients - Finally, the team has to present their overall plan with the clients to get the project evaluation. -Each team will briefly present their planning progress (in form of slides ppts) with the instructors to get coaching and on-going assessment. -Presentations with weights: 15%/each
assessments.Note: Option 1: The project must be guided by the instructor during the first lecture. Students will work in team of 4-6 students; The marking will be based on the application of the theory, the understanding of the clients and situation and ability to meet their requirements, the ability to analyse situations, develop and evaluate plans Evaluation will be based on both presentation and written report.
